scenarios.name: Fit a distant block using Zoom All

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open with its rectangular solid active in the MCAD Software
the block appears small within the viewport
the user opens the Zoom menu on the navigation bar
the menu offers Zoom, Zoom All, Zoom Window and Zoom Selected
the block appears larger and its visible outline fits within the viewport
the same part and orientation remain active
the user reopens the Zoom menu
Zoom All is marked as the selected action
the user selects Zoom and presses Escape
